sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT o.kalshi_order_id) AS filled_orders_all_cells, count(DISTINCT o.market_ticker) AS markets, max(o.created_at) AS last_order FROM live_orders o JOIN fills f ON f.kalshi_order_id = o.kalshi_order_id WHERE o.strategy = 'Kmmsell10' AND o.action = 'buy' AND o.side = 'no' AND o.created_at >= '2026-10-30 00:00+00'
